global_providers.name: Open Food Facts
global_providers.scope: Global community branded-food, GTIN, ingredients, label nutrition and images; country completeness unmeasured.
global_providers.access: Public API and bulk routes. Database ODbL; contents DbCL; images have separate CC BY-SA and other applicable rights.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Best open barcode starting point. Preserve provenance and assess share-alike duties before mixing/redistributing.

global_providers.name: Open Prices
global_providers.scope: Community price observations linked to products, places and evidence.
global_providers.access: Documented API; daily JSONL and Parquet exports; ODbL.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Useful open price layer; sparse observations do not establish current local stock or complete assortment.

global_providers.name: USDA FoodData Central
global_providers.scope: US reference/commercial foods and generic composition useful internationally with fit checks.
global_providers.access: Public-domain data; bulk CSV/JSON and API with key.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Strong reusable baseline. US food and fortification assumptions must remain visible outside the US.

global_providers.name: GS1 GDSN / certified data pools
global_providers.scope: Manufacturer/supplier product master data exchanged through subscribed networks.
global_providers.access: Commercial data-pool agreement and data-recipient entitlement. Country membership does not prove local food fields.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Assess 1WorldSync, Syndigo and other listed pools against GTINs, fields and recipient rights; do not assume one subscription unlocks every supplier.

global_providers.name: GS1 India DataKart
global_providers.scope: India product identity and brand-owner product data.
global_providers.access: Premium/licensed product-data service; agree permitted uses.
global_providers.offmenu_use: A stronger local product route for IN; not a global menu or retail-price dataset.

global_providers.name: GS1 Australia Trusted Content Service
global_providers.scope: Brand-owner product content from services including the National Product Catalogue and Smart Media; field and supplier coverage depend on the requested service.
global_providers.access: Paid subscription with API credentials or structured file delivery. Supplier-public content is available to subscribers; it is not an open-data licence.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Evaluate for Australian product identity/content. Confirm permitted transformation, caching, third-party use and service-provider authority for the proposed BYOC application.

global_providers.name: NIQ Label Insight / Brandbank
global_providers.scope: Commercial product content, ingredients and rich attributes, with market-specific offerings.
global_providers.access: Contracted SaaS/API access; content/attribution and export rights depend on agreement.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Request exact country, GTIN, nutrient and image entitlements. A global company footprint is not universal food coverage.

global_providers.name: fatsecret Platform
global_providers.scope: Publisher advertises 62+ verified country datasets and 26 languages; branded, generic, recipe and some restaurant foods.
global_providers.access: Developer credentials; premium/localisation entitlements; optional user OAuth for personal records.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Shortlist for multi-market BYOC. The long locale-code list is not proof of an equally rich standalone dataset per code. Ask for country-level sample files and match rates.

global_providers.name: Edamam
global_providers.scope: Food lookup, recipe discovery and nutrition-analysis services.
global_providers.access: Application credentials and plan terms; caching and database-building restrictions apply.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Suitable for licensed query-time capabilities, subject to terms. Do not treat API results as an unrestricted downloadable corpus.

global_providers.name: Nutritics Food Data API
global_providers.scope: Commercial food/recipe/allergen analysis and food-data integration.
global_providers.access: Commercial/API agreement; ask for national-source and derivative-use entitlements.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Evaluate micronutrients, country provenance, serving data and permitted storage separately.

global_providers.name: Spoonacular
global_providers.scope: Recipe, ingredient and food API offering.
global_providers.access: Commercial developer access is a potential route; reuse and caching terms were not fully verified in this pass.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Evaluate structured ingredients and recipes; estimated recipe costs are not local retailer quotes.

global_providers.name: FAO/INFOODS catalogue
global_providers.scope: Global discovery index for national, historical and regional composition tables.
global_providers.access: Public catalogue. Each underlying publication has its own access and rights.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Essential discovery spine, not a single freely licensed global nutrition database. Directory-only entries carry D.

global_providers.name: EFSA EU Food Composition Database
global_providers.scope: 2026 official page describes a harmonised resource drawn from at least 16 national databases.
global_providers.access: Open-access interface is documented; exact export route, licence and constituent coverage need validation.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Promising European harmonisation source. Do not extrapolate to all Europe or all branded products.

global_providers.name: EuroFIR FoodEXplorer / EMR and African data
global_providers.scope: Cross-database food composition tooling; some Eastern Mediterranean/African data access.
global_providers.access: Membership/research use and national-source conditions; publishing may need written permission.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Useful access/partnership route. Membership is not unrestricted commercial redistribution permission.

global_providers.name: SPC Pacific Nutrient Database
global_providers.scope: Regional Pacific food composition discovery candidate.
global_providers.access: Pacific Data Hub dataset metadata available; inspect file licence and release before import.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Useful starting point for island food matching; not proof of separate country-level representativeness.

global_providers.name: West African / Congo Basin / INCAP / Caribbean tables
global_providers.scope: Regional composition references for West Africa, Congo Basin, Central America and the English-speaking Caribbean.
global_providers.access: FAO catalogue leads; INCAP publisher PDF confirmed. The CFNI Caribbean reference is print-only (1995). Publication-specific rights remain unresolved.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Use local preparation/variety validation. A regional table cannot be counted as complete national coverage.

global_providers.name: FAO FPMA
global_providers.scope: Domestic commodity/market price series and international reference series.
global_providers.access: Public analytical tool; validate export and attribution conditions.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Supports affordability context and staple-price trends, not barcode-level current retail offers.

global_providers.name: WFP food prices via HDX
global_providers.scope: Country/market food-price datasets discoverable through HDX data-series and country filters.
global_providers.access: HDX CKAN discovery API documented. Check licence, update date and resource access for each country file.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Use market/commodity/time dimensions; no universal all-country or all-product completeness claim.

global_providers.name: Instacart Developer Platform
global_providers.scope: Documented recipe/shopping-list product discovery and shopping experiences.
global_providers.access: Developer API key and platform terms; endpoint and market availability must be checked.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Candidate for enabled US/Canada experiences; not an unrestricted catalogue export or a universal retailer-login connector.

global_providers.name: Square Catalog API
global_providers.scope: Items, variations and merchant catalogue content.
global_providers.access: Seller-authorised OAuth and application permissions.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Merchant BYOC route. Permission covers the connected seller, not every Square restaurant.

global_providers.name: Toast API
global_providers.scope: Restaurant/menu data within approved integrations.
global_providers.access: Partner/API access to authorised restaurants.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Restaurant partnership route; an ordinary diner account is insufficient.

global_providers.name: Deliverect
global_providers.scope: Menus/products and commerce integration within connected merchants/channels.
global_providers.access: Partner/merchant integration and contractual access.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Useful aggregation where restaurants grant authority; not public global menu mining.

global_providers.name: Uber Eats menu integration
global_providers.scope: Restaurant menu management and integration.
global_providers.access: Approved merchant/partner credentials and scopes.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Documented API existence does not confer access to all public restaurant menus.

global_providers.name: DoorDash Marketplace
global_providers.scope: Merchant menu setup/integration.
global_providers.access: Approved marketplace partnership and restaurant access.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Use for connected merchants; do not confuse delivery-only services with catalogue access.

global_providers.name: Wolt and local delivery platforms
global_providers.scope: Country-specific storefronts identify real menu/grocery leads.
global_providers.access: Public pages; a reusable consumer catalogue API was not verified. Wolt Drive is delivery logistics.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Seek commercial permission or merchant exports. Local rows document evidence, not usable API credentials.

global_providers.name: OpenStreetMap
global_providers.scope: Restaurant, shop, address and location data; some menu-URL tags.
global_providers.access: Open database with ODbL attribution/share-alike conditions.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Good place discovery. Menu links and tags are not complete dishes, prices or nutrition.

global_providers.name: Overture Maps Places
global_providers.scope: Bulk place/location discovery with categories and stable identity.
global_providers.access: Open releases with source/layer-specific attribution and licence documentation.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Useful venue identity layer; inspect the Places release licence instead of assuming all Overture themes have identical terms.

global_providers.name: Google Places
global_providers.scope: Commercial venue discovery and place metadata.
global_providers.access: BYO API key/billing; storage/caching restrictions and permitted exceptions.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Query-time venue enrichment candidate. Not a freely exportable global venue or menu corpus.

global_providers.name: FoodOn / FAO AGROVOC
global_providers.scope: Food concepts and multilingual controlled vocabulary.
global_providers.access: Published ontology/vocabulary services; apply each release licence.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Helpful identity and synonym mappings; they do not supply product labels, prices or complete nutrient tables.

global_providers.name: Wikibooks Cookbook / direct authors
global_providers.scope: Potential openly licensed recipe material and user-authored content.
global_providers.access: Wikibooks content has attribution/share-alike obligations; direct contributions need explicit rights.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Audit ingredient quantities and recipe provenance. Images may have different licences.

global_providers.name: openFDA food enforcement
global_providers.scope: US food recall/enforcement reports.
global_providers.access: Public documented API.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Match geography, identity and lots; do not interpret missing matches as a safety guarantee.

global_providers.name: UK FSA alerts / French RappelConso
global_providers.scope: UK food alerts API; French recall dataset including GTIN indexing.
global_providers.access: Public official APIs/data routes with dataset terms.
global_providers.offmenu_use: High-value structured safety starting points; expand regulator coverage separately for each market.

global_providers.name: USDA FoodKeeper
global_providers.scope: Food storage and handling reference data.
global_providers.access: Public official dataset listing; inspect release fields and terms.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Reference guidance is separate from actual household lot history and expiry.

global_providers.name: FAO national dietary-guideline directory
global_providers.scope: Discovery route to national food-based dietary guidance.
global_providers.access: Public directory; individual authorities supply underlying guidance.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Not every ISO entry has national guidance; track populations and publication dates explicitly.

global_providers.name: Apple HealthKit / Android Health Connect
global_providers.scope: Per-user body, activity and health observations on supported devices.
global_providers.access: Native app permissions and user consent; not ordinary browser OAuth feeds.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Use optional per-profile connections. Geography is not the primary availability dimension; device/OS/data-type permissions are.

global_providers.name: Withings / Garmin
global_providers.scope: Consented device/body/activity data.
global_providers.access: Withings OAuth; Garmin developer/partner approval and user permission.
global_providers.offmenu_use: Separate application approval from user authorisation; retain timestamps, units and device provenance.
